answer: The admission burn is multiplied by 8 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. The meadow multiplier is published, charged in cipher, and ridge lists each payment. A burst of registrations thus prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 1630 identities would post 762 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
